thread:
natalie (docs): Quick heads-up: we're standardizing the request metadata key across APIs from `meta` to `metadata`. This affects a handful of quickstarts and SDK helpers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1809

aryan (sdk): Short impact note: SDKs will accept both keys for two releases via a compat shim, but examples/docs will show `metadata`. It's a find-and-replace in most codebases.

pete (eng-runtime): Runtime will emit a `Deprecation-Warning: 'meta' will be removed in 45 days` header and accept both keys during the grace window. After that we'll 400 with a clear error message.

sasha (product): Timeline? We need coordinated messaging for Dedicated customers and a changelog entry.

natalie (docs): Plan: preview deploy tomorrow, canary flip in 48h, full flip 1 week after. Deprecation window: 45 days post-flip. We'll add a banner and a short migration recipe showing old->new examples.

linda (support): I'll prepare KB and canned replies. Also scanning top accounts for automation relying on `meta`.

aryan (sdk): Example snippet for copy/paste:
```js
// OLD
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'Hi', meta: { request_id: '123' } })
// NEW
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'Hi', metadata: { request_id: '123' } })
```
